description: This file defines the SharedStorage class within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace. It declares a plugin that implements shared storage functionality with notification mechanisms, remote connection handling, and integration with various interfaces such as ISharedStorage, ISharedStorageInspector, ISharedStorageLimit, and ISharedStorageCache. The class manages internal components, notifications, and lifecycle methods for initialization, deinitialization, and information retrieval.

classes.name: SharedStorage
classes.description: A plugin class implementing shared storage with notification and remote connection management, integrating multiple interfaces for storage, inspection, limits, and caching.

classes.name: Store2Notification
classes.description: Notification class for shared storage value changes, implementing ISharedStorage::INotification.

classes.name: RemoteConnectionNotification
classes.description: Notification class for remote connection events, implementing IRemoteConnection::INotification.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the SharedStorage plugin with the provided service.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the plugin, cleaning up resources.
